unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Solids of revolution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: A truncated cone is the part of a cone between its base and a plane parallel to the base; it has two bases with radii R and r.
stages.headlineEnglish: A truncated cone is the part of a cone between its base and a plane parallel to the base; it has two bases with radii R and r.

stages.headline: The axial section is an isosceles trapezoid with bases 2R and 2r; the generator satisfies l² = h² + (R − r)².
stages.headlineEnglish: The axial section is an isosceles trapezoid with bases 2R and 2r; the generator satisfies l² = h² + (R − r)².

stages.headline: The lateral area is S = π(R + r)l; e.g. R = 5, r = 2, h = 4 gives l = 5 and S = 35π.
stages.headlineEnglish: The lateral area is S = π(R + r)l; e.g. R = 5, r = 2, h = 4 gives l = 5 and S = 35π.
